title: VA-02-R1: GAO-25-106874 Recommendation 1 implementation artifact and milestone record
summary: GAO-25-106874 Recommendation 1 remains Open. Its normalized follow-through state is Promised; the record separates the named artifact, visibility, milestone, GAO review state, and remaining gap.
key_findings: Parent crosswalk: VA-02; child record: VA-02-R1.
Current GAO status: Open; status period: January 2026.

Response artifact: Independent total life-cycle cost estimate. VA planned an estimate only through the current Oracle Health contract ending May 2028; GAO said that does not cover the full modernization life cycle.
Artifact availability: Planned artifact described on the GAO page; no full-life-cycle estimate located.
Named milestone: May 2028 contract horizon; milestone state: Future but scope-limited.
GAO review state: GAO says planned scope is insufficient.
Remaining gap: An updated independent estimate covering the full modernization life cycle and following GAO best practices.

Continuation rule: Recheck for a full-life-cycle estimate, not only a current-contract estimate. Preserve VA-02 as the parent crosswalk; do not translate an artifact, promise, submission, or GAO review into implementation, closure, or operating outcome.
why_it_matters: Recommendation-specific follow-through makes it possible to distinguish a promise, an available artifact, a submission, GAO review, partial addressing, implementation, closure, and later operating outcomes.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves VA-02 as the parent crosswalk while publishing VA-02-R1 as a recommendation-specific child.
Records public artifact availability without treating availability as sufficiency or implementation.
Keeps named dates as monitors that do not pause the active content queue.
evidence_limits: A promised milestone is a monitor, not implementation evidence.
An agency artifact or submission is not implementation unless its scope satisfies the recommendation and the official record supports that conclusion.
Open – Partially Addressed is an official recommendation status, not the Phase 56F Partially Closed entity evidence state.
Recommendation closure would not by itself establish operating performance, readiness, safety, savings, value, or causation.
